import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load()
w=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c0_blocks.1.act_k10.npy')); b=-15.0051
torch.manual_seed(1); N=4096
xi=torch.randn(N,2); c=torch.rand(N)
a0=model.decode(net,xi,c).numpy()
lab=np.load('lab.npy')
ref=np.concatenate([a0,3*c.numpy()[:,None]],1)
def istarget(a,cc):
    q=np.concatenate([a,3*cc[:,None]],1)
    d=((q[:,None,:]-ref[None])**2).sum(-1)
    idx=np.argsort(d,1)[:,1:8]
    return lab[idx].mean(1)>0.5
def run(alpha,LO,HI,g,p,qq,thr=0.0):
    x=xi.clone(); fires=0
    with torch.no_grad():
      for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((N,),1-k/20)
        v,A=net.velocity(x,t,c,("blocks.1.act",),count=False)
        if LO<=k<HI:
            f=(A["blocks.1.act"]@w+b)>thr
            z=x[:,0]-(p+qq*c)
            s=torch.clamp(g*z,-1,1)
            v=v.clone(); v[f,0]-=alpha*s[f]
        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy()
cn=c.numpy()
print('baseline target share',istarget(a0,cn).mean(), lab.mean())
for alpha in [10,20,40]:
  for LO,HI in [(6,14),(8,16),(10,19),(4,19)]:
    a=run(alpha,LO,HI,3,-0.85,1.35)
    tg=istarget(a,cn)
    mv=np.linalg.norm(a-a0,axis=1)>0.3
    print(alpha,LO,HI,'lab still target',tg[lab].mean().round(3),'nonlab moved',mv[~lab].mean().round(3),'nonlab->target',tg[~lab].mean().round(3),'radius lab',np.linalg.norm(a[lab],axis=1).mean().round(2), np.linalg.norm(a[lab],axis=1).std().round(2))
